long_biography.plain_text:
Vinci Play's export business depends on adapting playground equipment to the safety expectations of different markets. Piotr Nadulny has explained how demanding standards led the Polish manufacturer to modify designs before entering some destinations. That attention to compliance sits alongside testing throughout production, from incoming materials to finished structures.

The company has also broadened its materials. Its recycled range uses recovered textiles and plastics for structural posts and reclaimed fishing nets for panels. Nadulny remains a shareholder and board member of the Polish manufacturing company, while serving as a director and significant shareholder of a British Vinci Play company.
